snapshotDate: Sample testimonials for this demo site
note: Illustrative testimonials for a fictional demo brand.

reviews.author: Dana R.
reviews.text: The crew shows up on the same day every week, cleans up after themselves, and texts when they are done. Our front yard has never looked this sharp.

reviews.author: Marcus T.
reviews.text: They walked us through three layout options before anything was built. The new patio, lighting and planting feel like they were always meant to be there.

reviews.author: Priya S.
reviews.text: Called about a broken drip line on a Monday and it was fixed on Wednesday. Clear price up front and no upsell.

reviews.author: Jordan K.
reviews.text: The turf install was clean and the edges along the pavers are tight. The kids and the dog are out there every day now.

reviews.author: Elena M.
reviews.text: Biweekly service fits our budget and the yard stays tidy between visits. Easy to pause when we travel in the summer.

reviews.author: Chris W.
reviews.text: Good communication from design to cleanup. The outdoor kitchen came in on the timeline they gave us.

reviews.author: Alicia B.
reviews.text: They cleared years of overgrowth, trimmed the palo verde and hauled everything away in one day. Great value.

reviews.author: Ben H.
reviews.text: The path lighting and new paver walk changed how the house looks at night. Professional crew start to finish.
